integrity_statement: Analytical proof and a stand-alone checker are supplied. The exact-weight \(t=1\) baseline is attributed to previously known equal-price Petersen spectral symmetry results. All statements are self-reviewed only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the Petersen graph with ten unit-price cycle edges, five matching edges of common price \(t>0\), a unit linear budget, and a symmetric continuous-time Laplacian spectral gap.
The price-frontier classification is not a discrete-time SLEM solution and does not generalize to other graphs or cost functions.
Finite exact and numerical checks supplement but do not replace the analytical universal proof.
The full historical record may contain equivalent specialized calculations; no independent audit is claimed.
title: A sharp spoke-price frontier for optimal spectral mixing on the Petersen graph
